cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Overall responsibility of leading the transition from new product development to manufacturing
Providing daily manufacturing support for existing products and for developing, implementing and improving processes
This position drives continuous improvement through operational efficiencies and innovative engineering solutions
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Plans, designs, and coordinates the integration of machinery and equipment into the manufacturing process of industrial establishment, applying engineering knowledge
Develops and writes equipment specifications, performance requirements, cost analysis, and proposals for integrating machining and equipment
Oversees installation to ensure machines and equipment are installed and functioning according to specifications
Determines parts supply, maintenance tasks, safety procedures, and service schedule required to maintain machines and equipment in prescribed condition
Recommends improvements in method, equipment, operating procedures, and working conditions
Develops models for alternate processing methods to test the feasibility of new applications of system components and recommend implementation of improved procedures
Optimize manufacturing processes to provide sustainable gains in cost-effectiveness and product performance through capital projects, statistical analysis, designed experiments, and procedural changes
Assist team leaders and team members in evaluating and implementing continuous improvement projects
B.S.E in Manufacturing / Robotics
Design & program (PLCs, HMIs, Robotics, and Vision Systems)
Computer-aided design (CAD)
Programmable Logic Controller (PLC Troubleshooting, Updating and program upload)
Universal Robotics UR Series (Install, Troubleshooting, and Programming) (this would be a plus)
Fanuc Industrial Robotics
ABB Industrial Robotics
This individual would be designing, building, programming, maintaining & troubleshooting, mostly feeding machines and automation
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in engineering or related field, or equivalent work experience with machining and/or tool making
5 Years of experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably in the metalworking industry, stamping, or machining
Experience working with ERP systems, SolidWorks, or AutoCAD
Preferred Requirements
Programming CNC, lathes, & milling machines
Automotive experience

cond_0109.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to join our team.
cond_0109.responsibilities:
Overall responsibility of leading the transition from new product development to manufacturing
Providing daily manufacturing support for existing products and for developing, implementing and improving processes
This position drives continuous improvement through operational efficiencies and innovative engineering solutions
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Plans, designs, and coordinates the integration of machinery and equipment into the manufacturing process of industrial establishment, applying engineering knowledge
Develops and writes equipment specifications, performance requirements, cost analysis, and proposals for integrating machining and equipment
Oversees installation to ensure machines and equipment are installed and functioning according to specifications
Determines parts supply, maintenance tasks, safety procedures, and service schedule required to maintain machines and equipment in prescribed condition
Recommends improvements in method, equipment, operating procedures, and working conditions
Develops models for alternate processing methods to test the feasibility of new applications of system components and recommend implementation of improved procedures
Optimize manufacturing processes to provide sustainable gains in cost-effectiveness and product performance through capital projects, statistical analysis, designed experiments, and procedural changes
Assist team leaders and team members in evaluating and implementing continuous improvement projects
B.S.E in Manufacturing / Robotics
Design & program (PLCs, HMIs, Robotics, and Vision Systems)
Computer-aided design (CAD)
Programmable Logic Controller (PLC Troubleshooting, Updating and program upload)
Universal Robotics UR Series (Install, Troubleshooting, and Programming) (this would be a plus)
Fanuc Industrial Robotics
ABB Industrial Robotics
This individual would be designing, building, programming, maintaining & troubleshooting, mostly feeding machines and automation
cond_0109.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in engineering or related field, or equivalent work experience with machining and/or tool making
5 Years of experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably in the metalworking industry, stamping, or machining
Experience working with ERP systems, SolidWorks, or AutoCAD
Preferred Requirements
Programming CNC, lathes, & milling machines
Automotive experience

ABB Industrial Robotics

Lead daily manufacturing support for existing products and execute process development and improvement
Drive continuous improvement through operational efficiencies and innovative engineering solutions
Plan, design, and direct the integration of machinery and equipment into the manufacturing process, applying engineering knowledge
Develop and write equipment specifications, performance requirements, cost analysis, and proposals for integrating machining and equipment
Oversee installation to ensure machines and equipment are installed and functioning according to specifications
Determine parts supply, maintenance tasks, safety procedures, and service schedules required to maintain machines and equipment in prescribed condition
Identify and recommend improvements in method, equipment, operating procedures, and working conditions
Develop models for alternate processing methods to test feasibility of new applications and recommend implementation of improved procedures
Optimize manufacturing processes to deliver sustainable gains in cost-effectiveness and product performance through capital projects, statistical analysis, designed experiments, and procedural changes
Lead team members in evaluating and implementing continuous improvement projects
Design, build, program, maintain, and troubleshoot feeding machines and automation
Design and program PLCs, HMIs, Robotics, and Vision Systems
Apply computer-aided design (CAD)
Execute PLC troubleshooting, updating, and program upload
Work with Fanuc and ABB Industrial Robotics
Universal Robotics UR Series (Install, Troubleshooting, and Programming) is a plus
cond_0647.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related field, or equivalent work experience with machining and/or tool making
5 Years of experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably in the metalworking industry, stamping, or machining
Experience working with ERP systems, SolidWorks, or AutoCAD
Programming CNC, lathes, and milling machines is a plus
Automotive experience is a strong plus

cond_0648.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to join our team. This role supports the transition from new product development to manufacturing, provides daily manufacturing support for existing products, and helps develop, implement, and improve processes. The work involves coordinating continuous improvement efforts through operational efficiencies and engineering solutions.
cond_0648.responsibilities:
Coordinate the integration of machinery and equipment into the manufacturing process, applying engineering knowledge
Work with the team to develop and write equipment specifications, performance requirements, cost analysis, and proposals for integrating machining and equipment
Support installation oversight to help ensure machines and equipment are installed and functioning according to specifications
Help determine parts supply, maintenance tasks, safety procedures, and service schedules required to maintain machines and equipment in prescribed condition
Share recommendations for improvements in method, equipment, operating procedures, and working conditions
Collaborate on developing models for alternate processing methods to test the feasibility of new applications of system components and support implementation of improved procedures
Work alongside the team to optimize manufacturing processes for sustainable gains in cost-effectiveness and product performance through capital projects, statistical analysis, designed experiments, and procedural changes
Assist team leaders and team members in evaluating and implementing continuous improvement projects
Coordinate design and programming work involving PLCs, HMIs, Robotics, and Vision Systems
Support CAD-based design tasks
Assist with PLC troubleshooting, updating, and program upload
Collaborate on installation, troubleshooting, and programming of Universal Robotics UR Series (a plus)
Work with Fanuc and ABB Industrial Robotics
Contribute to designing, building, programming, maintaining, and troubleshooting feeding machines and automation
cond_0648.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in engineering or related field, or equivalent work experience with machining and/or tool making
5 Years of experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably in the metalworking industry, stamping, or machining
Experience working with ERP systems, SolidWorks, or AutoCAD
Programming CNC, lathes, and milling machines is a plus
Automotive experience is a huge plus
